prompt: Generate an API reference document for the tzro tools package. List every exported tool constructor function (NewReadFileTool, NewWriteFileTool, etc.), its parameters, return type, and a one-sentence description. Format as a markdown table. Write the output to 'docs/api_reference.md'.

criteria.name: Correctness
criteria.description: Tool names, parameter types, and return types match the actual code

criteria.name: Completeness
criteria.description: Every exported constructor in the tools package is documented

criteria.name: Formatting
criteria.description: Clean markdown table with consistent columns: Function, Parameters, Returns, Description

criteria.name: Accuracy
criteria.description: Descriptions accurately reflect what each tool does

prompt: Read the ADR files in docs/adr/ and generate a migration guide for developers upgrading through the major architectural changes. Group ADRs chronologically, identify breaking changes, and provide before/after code patterns where applicable. Write the output to 'docs/migration_guide.md'.

criteria.name: Correctness
criteria.description: ADR references are accurate — IDs, titles, and decisions match the actual files

criteria.name: Completeness
criteria.description: Covers all ADRs that represent breaking changes or API shifts

criteria.name: Structure
criteria.description: Chronological grouping with clear version boundaries and before/after patterns

criteria.name: Actionability
criteria.description: A developer could follow this guide to upgrade — not just a list of changes

prompt: Use git_log to retrieve the last 50 commits on the main branch. Analyze the commit messages and generate a structured changelog grouped by category (features, fixes, refactors, docs). Each entry should have the commit hash (short), a cleaned-up description, and the affected component. Write the output to 'docs/changelog.md'.

criteria.name: Correctness
criteria.description: Commit hashes and messages match actual git history

criteria.name: Completeness
criteria.description: All 50 commits categorized — none missing or duplicated

criteria.name: Structure
criteria.description: Clean markdown with category headers, consistent entry format

criteria.name: Synthesis
criteria.description: Commit messages are cleaned up and component attribution is accurate — not just raw git output

prompt: Generate an operational runbook for running and troubleshooting tzro. Cover: initial setup, starting/stopping sidecars, common error scenarios and their fixes, performance tuning (context sizes, step budgets), and health check procedures. Base it on the actual configuration options in internal/config/ and the sidecar management code in internal/inference/. Write the output to 'docs/runbook.md'.

criteria.name: Correctness
criteria.description: Configuration field names, default values, and sidecar commands match the actual code

criteria.name: Completeness
criteria.description: Covers setup, sidecar lifecycle, error scenarios, tuning, and health checks

criteria.name: Actionability
criteria.description: A new operator could use this runbook to deploy, monitor, and troubleshoot tzro

criteria.name: Structure
criteria.description: Organized as a runbook with clear sections, step-by-step procedures, and decision trees

prompt: Analyze the error handling patterns across the tzro codebase (internal/executor, internal/inference, internal/compiler, internal/task). Identify every distinct error type, where it originates, what triggers it, and how it propagates. Generate an error triage guide that maps symptoms to root causes with suggested fixes. Write the output to 'docs/error_triage.md'.

criteria.name: Correctness
criteria.description: Error types, originating files, and propagation paths match the actual code

criteria.name: Completeness
criteria.description: Covers all major error types across the four packages — not just the obvious ones

criteria.name: Actionability
criteria.description: Symptom-to-root-cause mapping is specific enough to be useful for debugging

criteria.name: Structure
criteria.description: Organized by symptom (what the user sees) with clear paths to root cause and fix
